title: Past incident: payments-api latency after ORM upgrade
text: 2025-11-03: p99 latency rose to 3.8s after ORM library upgrade. Root cause: N+1 query pattern introduced by lazy-loading change, saturating the connection pool. Resolution: service restart mitigated for 40 minutes, permanent fix was reverting the ORM config. Time to resolve: 2h10m.

title: Past incident: checkout errors from network partition
text: 2025-12-19: checkout 5xx rate 9%. Initially suspected DB pool exhaustion, but pool utilization was normal; root cause was a network partition between app subnet and DB subnet after a firewall rule push. Lesson: always check network path before restarting services.
